v 3.4.3

Applied local compatibility patches

Windows clang/MinGW new-handler compatibility:
- Status: applied to src/alloc.c.
- The weak std::get_new_handler fallback is limited to non-Windows targets.
- Windows uses the existing NULL fallback because COFF linkers do not reliably
  coalesce the weak fallback with the C++ runtime definition.
- WaterWall does not use mimalloc's mi_new APIs.
- Reapply this guard when updating the vendored mimalloc sources.
